rust_summary: a living entity's experience on death, which a mod can change or cancel (`native_living_experience_drop`).
doc_summary: the experience a living entity drops on death: `native_living_experience_drop(dimension, entity, kind, player, original, experience, cancel)` is heard once the amount is known, before `ExperienceOrb.award` splits it into orbs, as NeoForge's `LivingExperienceDropEvent` is. `entity` is the dying entity's id and `kind` its type, `player` the player credited with the kill (None when there is none or they have logged out), `original` what vanilla would award and `experience` what will. A mod may change `experience`, or set `cancel` to drop no experience at all. Not heard when nothing would drop, nor when a sculk catalyst consumed it. Server-side. Bundles need "hooks": @API:living_experience_drop@.
